development_notes.wpt-trusted-idl-20261108a: Metadata checks passed; new iframe fixture had no Page, so contentWindow was null.
development_notes.wpt-trusted-idl-20261108b: Factory lookup through the initial WindowProxy passed. Descriptor lookup on that facade is unsupported; test now re-reads the created realm global for the reciprocal getter.
development_notes.wpt-token-bridge-20261108a: Combined test run crashed while a rendering test drained a queued load task belonging to an earlier retired fixture. Fixtures had finalized and released storage without destroying documents. Teardown is being corrected; the failed run is retained.
development_notes.wpt-token-bridge-20261108b: Corrected fixture destruction prevents the previous queued-task crash. New coverage test has a syntax error (fixed subsequently); existing SVG gradient paint-command assertion reports 0 instead of 2.
development_notes.wpt-token-svg-control-20261108a: Compiled the existing SVG bridge test file in isolation with the legacy class-list bootstrap and initialization. The same gradient paint-command assertion fails (0 instead of 2), with the other two tests passing. Canonical candidate source was restored immediately after compilation.
development_notes.wpt-token-bridge-20261108c: 39 focused tests pass after syntax correction; SVG rendering tests are retained in their separate failing control rather than included in this binding cohort.
development_notes.wpt-token-bridge-20261108d: 39 tests pass with production allocation; also pass with shared node properties disabled. Iteration now uses the specified Array intrinsics.
development_notes.wpt-token-bridge-20261108e: The same 39 tests pass with ordinary allocation. Later checks add exact PutForwards semantics and tests.
development_notes.wpt-token-bridge-20261108f: 40 tests pass after adding PutForwards semantics: public getter lookup, original uncoerced assignment value, and non-throwing failed assignment. A syntax precheck caught a misplaced test block before compilation; that failed precheck is retained.
development_notes.wpt-token-bridge-20261108g: Final 40 tests pass with production allocation, including prototype fallback for unsupported indexes. Same 40 also pass with shared node properties disabled. Executable identity is recorded before and after both runs.
development_notes.wpt-token-bridge-20261108h: Final 40 tests pass with ordinary allocation; executable identity recorded before and after. Listed input hashes and the startup fragment remain unchanged.

changes: Trusted Types operation arity and getter metadata, with native Window receiver checking and correct owning factories across iframe globals and initial proxies.
DOMTokenList add/remove validate every token before changing their ordered set.

classList, part, relList, sandbox, output.htmlFor and link.sizes bind to native token algorithms; indexed reads, prototype fallback, live state, Array iteration intrinsics, and PutForwards assignments are implemented.
Native document fixtures are destroyed before finalizing and releasing storage, cancelling their pending load tasks.
